1: // Package cache provides a concurrency-safe in-memory key/value cache whose
2: // entries expire after a configurable time-to-live.
3: package cache
4: 
5: import (
6: 	"sync"
7: 	"time"
8: )
9: 
10: // entry is a value together with the instant at which it stops being visible.
11: type entry struct {
12: 	val       any
13: 	expiresAt time.Time
14: }
15: 
16: // Cache is a concurrency-safe in-memory cache. Its zero value is ready to use.
17: //
18: // A Cache must not be copied after first use.
19: type Cache struct {
20: 	mu    sync.RWMutex
21: 	items map[string]entry
22: }
23: 
24: // Set stores val under key and replaces any previous value. A positive ttl is
25: // measured from this call; a ttl less than or equal to zero removes key
26: // immediately so that any previous value is no longer visible.
27: func (c *Cache) Set(key string, val any, ttl time.Duration) {
28: 	c.mu.Lock()
29: 	defer c.mu.Unlock()
30: 
31: 	if ttl <= 0 {
32: 		delete(c.items, key)
33: 		return
34: 	}
35: 	if c.items == nil {
36: 		c.items = make(map[string]entry)
37: 	}
38: 	c.items[key] = entry{
39: 		val:       val,
40: 		expiresAt: time.Now().Add(ttl),
41: 	}
42: }
43: 
44: // Get returns the value stored under key and whether it is currently visible.
45: // Missing and expired entries return (nil, false); a visible nil value returns
46: // (nil, true). Expired entries are hidden without being removed from the map.
47: func (c *Cache) Get(key string) (any, bool) {
48: 	c.mu.RLock()
49: 	defer c.mu.RUnlock()
50: 
51: 	e, ok := c.items[key]
52: 	if !ok {
53: 		return nil, false
54: 	}
55: 	if c.isExpired(e, time.Now()) {
56: 		return nil, false
57: 	}
58: 	return e.val, true
59: }
60: 
61: // Delete removes key. Deleting a missing key is a no-op and is safe to repeat.
62: func (c *Cache) Delete(key string) {
63: 	c.mu.Lock()
64: 	defer c.mu.Unlock()
65: 
66: 	delete(c.items, key)
67: }
68: 
69: // isExpired reports whether e is expired at now. An entry is expired once the
70: // current instant reaches or passes its expiry instant.
71: func (c *Cache) isExpired(e entry, now time.Time) bool {
72: 	return !now.Before(e.expiresAt)
